fact: The revised 2024-2025 budget law, art. 108, requires every landowner to acquire a secure electronic land title, with fees of 12,000 to 150,000 BIF per are capped at 3,000,000 BIF, as explained by the OBR on 28 February 2025.
title: Tout propriétaire foncière est tenu d'acquérir un titre foncier électronique sécurisé
